faqs.a: QR Se Print cyber cafe aur print shop ke liye ek automatic print software hai. Aap apni shop ka QR code lagate ho — customer apne phone se scan karke file upload karta hai, payment karta hai, aur print aapke printer se automatic nikal jata hai. Na WhatsApp pe file mangni padti hai, na pendrive, na email.

Shop par laga QR code scan karo, file select karo (PDF, photo — ek saath kai files), edit karo (crop, rotate, brightness), payment karo (online ya counter cash) — print automatic nikal jata hai. Poora kaam customer ke phone se, 1 minute me.

faqs.q: WhatsApp pe file lene se ye better kyun hai?
faqs.a: WhatsApp me aapka personal number public ho jata hai, chat me files kho jaati hain, aur hisaab manually rakhna padta hai. QR Se Print me number private rehta hai, har print ka payment record automatic banta hai, aur customer ki file print hote hi khud delete ho jaati hai.

faqs.q: Kaunse printer ke saath chalta hai?
faqs.a: Har Windows printer ke saath — HP, Canon, Epson, Brother, sab. B&W aur Color ke liye alag printer set kar sakte ho. Advance me 4x6 photo printer, A3 bada printer aur duplex (dono side) printing bhi support hai.

faqs.q: Payment kaise milta hai? Koi commission?
faqs.a: Do tarike: counter par cash, ya online payment (Razorpay/PhonePe) jo seedha aapke account me jata hai. Hum beech me nahi aate — koi commission nahi, unlimited prints.

Free demo se shuru karo. Phir Rs 299/month ka monthly plan, Rs 599/899/1099 ke yearly plan (Starter/Pro/Premium), ya Rs 1999 one-time lifetime plan — ek baar do, hamesha chalao. Koi hidden charge nahi, koi per-print commission nahi.

faqs.q: Internet chala jaye to print ka kya hoga?
faqs.a: Customer ke jobs queue me safe rehte hain. Internet wapas aate hi software khud jobs utha ke print nikal deta hai — kuch khota nahi.
